title: IMAP auth credential store not shared with stoa-auth: divergent user database
description: imap/config.rs defines its own AuthConfig and UserCredential types, independent of stoa-auth::AuthConfig. An operator adding a user to imap.toml does not give that user JMAP access, and vice versa. IMAP has no credential_file, client_certs, or trusted_issuers. This will generate user confusion and duplicate maintenance. The IMAP crate should import stoa-auth::AuthConfig or document explicitly that it maintains a separate user database.
